purpose: Hard-bound screen for non-native or approximate representations after high-acceptance verifier/draft audit found no source-ready route.

current_accepted_sota.strict_ram_rule: 16GB cgroup including file page cache, MemorySwapMax=0, no swap/OOM

hard_requirements.correctness_gate: Any non-exact representation must pass fixed-text top1 before a strict cold performance benchmark, then France semantic correctness before SOTA promotion.

candidate_screen.candidate: native MXFP4 lossless compression, dedup, zero-block skip, or dictionary representation
candidate_screen.reason: The representation is exact but cannot get close to the required 5.33x payload reduction. Native MXFP4 hot payload is already information-dense.

candidate_screen.candidate: CPU-compatible Q8_0 exact arithmetic with resident source
candidate_screen.correctness_status: fixed-text top1 passed for all-up/all-down combined skip in validation artifact
candidate_screen.reason: This path preserves top1 but does not reduce source payload enough. The fitting top768 pool has a 6.48 tok/s zero-overhead ceiling; the first positive top4096 pool needs 17 GiB and cannot fit with the accepted gate cache/workspace.

candidate_screen.candidate: standalone MMVQ/codebook approximate hot resident skip/write

performance_evidence.gate_cache_effect: direct pool displaced accepted gate cache allocation

candidate_screen.reason: The first logit-affecting correctness gate failed before performance, and the direct pool broke accepted gate-cache behavior. Compare-only success is not a valid correctness proof.

candidate_screen.candidate: graph-level zero-transfer sparse MMVQ/top64 retained hot branch
candidate_screen.reason: The paper bound has only about 19 ms margin and requires an existing retained CUDA gate/up/down dataflow. Current accepted graph exposes no retained gate tensor, no active hot manager, and a final combine copy/scheduler overhead would consume the margin even before proving top1 for MMVQ write.

candidate_screen.candidate: low-bit recoding, low-rank, sparsification, or learned codebook beyond existing MMVQ
candidate_screen.payload_requirement: must show >5.33x effective payload reduction or equivalent source+CPU fallback reduction, while preserving fixed-text top1
candidate_screen.overhead_requirement: decode overhead must remain below the top4096 1008.842 ms slack after all kernel, transfer, sync, scatter, and scheduler costs
candidate_screen.reason: No current artifact proves token stability for a more aggressive approximation. The closest MMVQ write already changed top1, so any new representation must start with a separate offline/top1 proof before runtime source changes.

candidate_screen.candidate: prompt-specific route/output cache or lookup cache
candidate_screen.reason: A prompt-specific cache cannot be claimed as a vendor model token-rate SOTA for arbitrary prompts unless it has a verifier proving greedy-stream equivalence and prompt-set correctness. Historical lookup/ngram/no-source speculation did not provide this.

implementation_gates_if_reopened: A new approximate representation must first run in compare-only mode under strict 16GB/no-swap cgroup and prove fixed-text top1 equality.
The default accepted path must remain byte-for-byte/top1 unchanged when the new env is disabled.
Any logit-writing mode must pass fixed-text top1 before France generation or performance.
The path must explicitly account for VRAM pool size, lost gate cache slots, CUDA workspace, H2D/D2H, scatter, synchronization, scheduler copies, host RAM, file page cache, TTFT, and rollback.

Only after these gates pass may strict cold France be benchmarked; promotion requires eval_tok_s > 4.4, TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms, memory.peak <= 16000000000 bytes including page cache, no swap/OOM, and coherent France output.

decision.reason: Every current non-native route fails one of the hard gates: exact compression is far below the needed 5.33x reduction; Q8_0 exact arithmetic is token-stable but has a sub-10 fitting-payload ceiling; standalone MMVQ failed fixed-text top1 and gate-cache preservation; graph-level zero-transfer MMVQ lacks the retained CUDA dataflow and has only ~19 ms paper margin; more aggressive low-rank/sparsified/codebook representations have no top1 proof.
next_allowed_work: Do not implement a new runtime representation path from the current evidence.
A future non-native route must begin with an offline or compare-only artifact that proves fixed-text top1 and the >5.33x/equivalent fallback reduction before source changes.
If no such representation appears, the remaining 10 tok/s route requires a new external high-acceptance verifier/draft artifact or a new exact graph/dataflow breakthrough with a hard bound above 10.
